title: better loot zibura
description: Improve vanilla structure loot. Compatible with Ctov, Kaleidoscope Cookery, Farmers delight, Farm and Charm, and more
body:
## **NOTE: (0.3.0)**  Please ensure you have KubeLoader, LootJS, Kubejs, Polymorph, and Rhino installed. In 1.20.1 you also have to download Architectury API. If something went wrong, try /reload first. **How it works:** This mod **does not add any new items** on its own. Instead, it distributes vanilla and mod items into the loot chests where they naturally belong. You do **not** need to install every compatible mod, as the mod will only handle existing items. For example, if you only have _Farmer's Delight_ installed, items from _Farm & Charm_ will simply be skipped and won't appear. 

1. village houses

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XdmLK51k/images/dda0212a585873c7d83d067e476d83bee7900f96.jpeg) And also for ctov: ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XdmLK51k/images/3e6b7120a88be15ccb3eabdc4892ea8159e20f77.png)   **_Mod items displayed above require their corresponding mods to be installed._** Each chest of village house now have **5** parts: **base crops, other crops, wealth & tools, cuisine, and drinks**.  When multiple mods introduce the same crop (like tomatoes), the mod **prioritizes them in this order**: Kaleidoscope Cookery → Farmer's Delight → Farm & Charm → Other Mods. If you prefer the Farmer's Delight version (or any other variant), you can easily **swap them** directly in your **inventory crafting grid.** Please note that with a low probability, some village house chests may actually contain **Carpenter** or **Bakery** loot. They are visually indistinguishable from regular chests, so you'll have to open them to find out. By the way, to make the world more realistic, all food items have been completely **removed from underground** structures, like dungeon. After all, fresh cuisine shouldn’t just sit perfectly preserved in deep, abandoned dungeons for centuries. These items are chosen based on **real-world climate and cultural backgrounds** to fit each biome. That said, please keep in mind that I might have missed or misinterpreted some details, so feel free to point out. ### **Compatible Mods:** **Recommended:** _Kaleidoscope Cookery_, _Farmer's Delight_, _Corn Delight_   **Optional:** _Barbecue's Delight_, _Berry Good_, _Brewery_, _Brewin' and Chewin'_, _Crate Delight_, _Dumplings Delight_, _Farm & Charm_, _Let's do: bakery_, _Let's do: brewery_, _Kaleidoscope Chinese Food_, _Kaleidoscope Nether_, _KitchenKarrot_, _More Delight_, _Rationcraft_, _Rustic Delight_, _Vanilla Cookbook_, _Youkai's Feasts / Youkai's Homecoming_, _Muffins Thai Delight_, _Vintage Delight_, _Pineapple delight_ If you launch the game without any of mods listed above, the plain village chest may look like this: ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XdmLK51k/images/e2c3a307d2d4d1d7b879050dda02c96d5bbe548f.png)

2. village professions

 
**_Mod items displayed above require their corresponding mods to be installed._** Houses like the **butcher, mason, shepherd and tannery** now change their inventory based on the **biome.** Some items **reflect the local environment**. For instance, a desert Shepherd offers green dye from cacti, whereas a plains Shepherd offers red, yellow and blue dyes from poppy, dandelion and cornflower. Explore the world and find other loot variants. **All other village professions have been modified as well**, but they only have a single loot set that remains the same everywhere. ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XdmLK51k/images/78e70066b3929e69c1a29b29e65172335960a9ec.png) ### **Compatible Mods:** **Recommended:**   **Optional:** _Let's do_ _Bakery_, _Chalk_, _Explorer's Compass_, _Nature's Compass_, _Sawmill_, _Stone Chest_, _Stoneworks_, _Traveler's Backpack_, _Wooden Shears_, _Kaleidoscope Cookery_, _Supplementaries_

3. Treasure Chests

**Iron ingots** in treasure chests have been **deleted**. There are **more diamonds** instead.  **Shipwreck:** Treasure chests may now contain all types of pottery sherds, music discs, and armor trims. Food chests may contain ancient crops like torchflowers and pitcher pods. **Woodland Mansion:** Each chest have 1 of 6 themes: Weapons, Treasures, Music, Wool & Dyes, Cuisine, and Food Supply.  ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1760/995/minecraft-png.png) ### **Associated Mods:** **Recommended:** _Supplementaries_   **Optional:** _Immersive Armors_, _Immersive Enchanting_   ## **Additional Notes** 1. This mod clears out the original vanilla Minecraft loot tables, so some datapacks may not work. 2. Removed the cakes and cameras added to various structures by the _Touhou Little Maid_  mod to maintain overall immersion. 3. The Nether, the End, Igloo, Stronghold Corridor, Stronghold Supply, Ancient City and Trial Chambers **have not been modified yet**. 4. **Paired Spawns:** Whenever a crate or sack of crops appears, its corresponding individual crop item spawns with it. (1.21.1 only)
